history_events.description: Drinking becomes a daily habit after a promotion to supervisor.
Mentions his drinking to a family doctor for the first time.
Tries to cut down alone; returns to daily drinking within weeks.
Starts outpatient counseling at a community clinic.
A workplace incident leads to a formal meeting with his employer.
Joins a mutual-help group after leaving the inpatient stay.
Returns to daily drinking; group attendance becomes irregular.
Begins his current period without drinking.
